liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big River** (1 review): The band's performance energy ramps up significantly by this track [3]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Keith plays Rhodes while Phil plays far-out bass lines in this version [7]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition to I Know You Rider is short but very hot [6]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): This China Cat Sunflower to I Know You Rider transition is considered the best [9]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Jerry plays intensely rather than just noodling during this performance [2]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-05-17.sbd.miller.89972.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 174 min; rated 4.41/5 by 22 [1]. Said about its sound: The soundboard recording is described as exceptionally clean and high quality; The mix improves noticeably after the first few songs of the set; The 1974 sound system can sound sharp in the high end frequencies [1][2][5][13]

## Around the show

- A wall of sound picture was taken at the PNE Coliseum [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-05-17.sbd.miller.89972.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD D [1]. Also: Charlie Miller is credited with guaranteeing the quality of this recording; Charlie Miller's soundboards are noted for superior sound and substantial reconstruction; The recording lineage includes unknown mics, cassette master, cassette, and HD transfer [1][3][4]
